scoring_justification: Checker recomputes initial SIFs and final crack front coordinates using the same analytical formulas and propagation algorithm, comparing via element-wise tolerance and RMSE.

outputs.description: Stress intensity factors for the initial pressurized circular crack (Case 3) at 36 angles.
Global coordinates of the final fitted elliptical crack front after 20 propagation steps for Case 3.

output_contract.notes: The initial SIFs are computed from the closed-form expressions for a circular crack; the final front is obtained by iterating the fictitious planar elliptical crack propagation method. The checker will recompute the same quantities independently from the same parameters and formulas, comparing element-wise absolute differences (for SIFs) and RMSE (for the crack front) against fixed tolerances.

steps.description: Element-wise absolute difference between agent's SIFs and recomputed reference SIFs; maximum absolute difference must not exceed 1e-6 Pa√m.
RMSE between agent's final crack front coordinates and recomputed reference; RMSE must not exceed 0.001 m.
